regions.name: Memphis–Shelby County
regions.model_scope: Memphis–Shelby independent 2024–25 grade-school models use exact NCES LEA 4700148 / CCD TN-00792 / EDC 792 identities. All 154 audited operational pure lower offered and reconciled enrolled grade profiles remain searchable. Four specifically named shared-time schools retain unresolved enrolled-versus-served income/outcome attribution and have unavailable comparison metrics. Original TNReady regular All Students G38 Levels 3–4 published rates and own reported individual direct certification / same-year school membership support separate fixed 142 Math, 147 ELA and independently fitted 142 Combined models. Charters, income extremes and influence remain included. The school-specific note does not certify attribution coverage at nonlisted schools. Native-only, high, mixed, primary and other excluded configurations remain outside. Valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; all sampling intervals are unavailable.
regions.map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Memphis–Shelby source release.
